rationale.complete: Round 1 plus round 1b (2026-10-04): replication on 8 input configurations (shared goal vectors, bge and gte-modernbert, DQ5 dedupe, style residualization) and three native tests (G44 room contrast, NE38 single-agent reassignment, G26 agent-set goal) with dated predictions; per-period estimates written. Holdout not run; the two-state re-mapping is not started.
rationale.faithfulness: P1 (fluctuations predict who moves) fails in every round-1b configuration and again along an agent-set goal (G26); the single-agent reassignment (NE38) lands outside the support of the unforced distribution, which no exponential tilt can reach. Only the existence of a push holds. Exploratory only, so not 0.
rationale.usefulness: A validated, model-robust instrument (goal-direction projection, noise-corrected variance) and a clear negative for operators: pre-goal fluctuation does not forecast compliance; an operator-written target acts as a room-specific field while 'pick your own goal' does not. Nothing to steer with yet.

one_line: Goals are not Legendre pushes: free-week fluctuations do not predict who follows a goal; agents converge on a common target instead.
